# Zenemoo
> Formerly known as QuantumCoders Data Solution

## Overview
Zenemoo (https://zenemoo.in) is an AI-powered language and data services company specializing in enterprise data annotation, multilingual transcription, translation, AI datasets, LLM evaluation, image annotation, audio annotation, video annotation, and enterprise AI data solutions.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- Audio Transcription & Timestamping (Odia, Hindi, Indian English, Bengali, Telugu, Tamil)
- Audio Segmentation & Waveform Quality Control
- Multilingual Speech Recording & AI Dataset Collection
- Data Annotation & Bounding Box Labeling
- LLM Evaluation & RLHF Training Data Preparation
- Working with DesiCrew since 2023

## Production SLA & Telemetry
- 500+ Minutes Daily Audio Output Capacity (10,000+ Mins Monthly Production Target)
- 99.9%+ Accuracy Rating SLA with Super QC Verification
- 50+ Active Team Members (40 Transcribers + 10 QC Leads)
- 24/7 Enterprise SLAs with < 2 Hours Response Time Guarantee
